title: RoleResponse
description: Full role record returned from create, read, or update operations

id.description: Unique numeric identifier of the role

createdBy.description: ID of the user who created the role

createdOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the role was created

updatedBy.description: ID of the user who last modified the role

updatedOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last update
